findings.title: No EMC filtering near J303
findings.description: Connector J303 (Conn_01x01) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J303. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J303
